### AbCellera to Present at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 9, 2026


September 2, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/223776925/files/doc_news/AbCellera-to-Present-at-the-Cantor-Global-Healthcare-Conference-on-September-9-2026-2026.pdf)


VANCOUVER, British Columbia--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[AbCellera](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.abcellera.com&esheet=54597563&newsitemid=20260902389676&lan=en-US&anchor=AbCellera&index=1&md5=519ee4ab31044ae192758f9dedbf7503) (Nasdaq: ABCL) announced that **** the Company will present at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 9, 2026.


A live audio webcast of the presentation may be accessed through a link that will be posted on[AbCellera's Investor Relations website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.abcellera.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54597563&newsitemid=20260902389676&lan=en-US&anchor=AbCellera%27s+Investor+Relations+website&index=2&md5=671aa4b3939687cc7b760056294bc3a1) . A replay will be available through the same link following the presentation.


**About AbCellera Biologics Inc.**


[AbCellera](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.abcellera.com&esheet=54597563&newsitemid=20260902389676&lan=en-US&anchor=AbCellera&index=3&md5=ddb57ad95afe34f5320f4e1a9212d05a) (Nasdaq: ABCL) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing first-in-class antibody-based medicines in the areas of endocrinology, women’s health, immunology, oncology, and more. For more information, please visit[www.abcellera.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.abcellera.com&esheet=54597563&newsitemid=20260902389676&lan=en-US&anchor=www.abcellera.com&index=4&md5=48f73cab75bc93a5f31958d00a68e6d0) .
